assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: visual exploration for redesigned WaterGuard desktop water network operations workspace, reference only. Create a very refined functional operator UI, NO SIDEBAR. Wide landscape 16:10. One slim white top horizontal navigation: WaterGuard wordmark left, four Chinese navigation tabs 应急工作台 / 方案对照 / 建模与仿真 / 证据中心, active thin cobalt underline. Light mist-white page, generous horizontal margins, ink-navy typography, restrained pure cobalt blue accents, slate gray secondary text, tiny muted orange warning only. Large clean heading 供水应急工作台 at top left. Right source select and subtle BENCHMARK tag. Below: very crisp thin incident context row, four large navy metric figures in an open row divided by fine vertical rules, no card mosaic. Dominant wide technical graph workspace: pale cool-gray canvas with fine blue water network lines and nodes, orange isolated fault marker. White narrow inspector on right separated by thin rule. Bottom: blue time scrubber and minimalist five-step admission statuses. Small chart and modeling thumbnail lower. Premium scientific engineering software, calm academic editorial precision, typography large and legible, fine restrained outlines, no dark backgrounds, no green blocks, no glossy gradients, no decoration clutter, no hardware frame, no watermark. All sample numbers are design placeholders only.
